From: Audra Simmons <audra@novusbank.com>

Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Novus - SOC 2 recert & regional log retention change

Rachel / Samir —

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our upcoming renewals with regulators we need to update our SOC 2 scope: we must keep a separate 24-month audit log slice for US customer transactions and a 36-month archive for EU accounts (regulatory request). That implies:
- a short-term export of last 36 months of logs for EU accounts, staged for auditors;
- an ongoing rolling retention split (US 24m / EU 36m);
- a temporary throughput increase for the evidence export window (expected ~3 days of heavy export);

Can Redwood help coordinate the evidence handoff and provide a short-term capacity uplift for the export window? We also need an index of what evidence artifacts we should expect to deliver.

Attaching a short spreadsheet with the fields we collect (soc2_evidence_index.csv) — it’s a first draft.

Thanks,
Audra Simmons
Head of Audit & Controls
Novus Bank
(attached: soc2_evidence_index.csv - text/csv)

Audra —

Appreciate the detail. High level plan that we can execute quickly:
1) Evidence index finalization — we’ll review your CSV and map Redwood artifacts to each line item (config, access logs, change history, snapshots).
2) Staging area + export window — create a secure, time-limited staging bucket (encrypted) and run a controlled export for the EU 36m slice plus the US 24m slice.
3) Temporary capacity uplift — we can provide a 72-hour burst on Dedicated to process exports, plus an optional parallel export worker pool.
4) Retention split — implement a retention policy in the log pipeline: tag records by region at write-time and apply different retention lifecycles.

Next actions I propose:
- Kim (cc) will validate retention policy feasibility & timeline.
- Jonas (cc) will put together a capacity quote for the 72-hour export and seat uplift.
- I’ll schedule a 30-min ops call to align on exact evidence mapping and delivery windows.

Proposed ops call: Tuesday 2026-11-23 10:00 PT — does that work?

I’ve attached the initial mapping template and will upload a more detailed playbook after we chat.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Customer Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
(redwood.ai)

On Tue, 23 Nov 2026 10:00:00 -0800, Rachel Kim wrote:
> Proposed ops call: Tuesday 2026-11-23 10:00 PT — does that work?

That time works for my schedule — I’ll be on the call to confirm retention mechanics. Quick notes ahead of the call:

- Technical approach: we can tag logs with a region code on ingest using the existing routing layer, then funnel EU-tagged logs to a 36-month lifecycle and US-tagged logs to 24 months.
- Data sovereignty: exporting the EU 36m slice will require a review of PII redaction rules — recommend we run the export through a compliance filter prior to staging.
- Export throughput: the export will be read-heavy; estimated IO is ~1.2 TB/day per 100M events. For a worst-case 3-day export we should provision a dedicated worker pool plus increased egress budget.

I’ve attached a spec for the export format and expected fields (log_export_spec.pdf).

Kimberly Park
Director, Reliability & Security Operations | Redwood Inference
(attached: log_export_spec.pdf - application/pdf)

I’ve added the deal to HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/NB-2026-042 — Marissa, can you prepare an amendment draft with the credit language and the proposed term?
